main_issue: Who will complete D's half-done analysis section for Thursday's pitch after D's bereavement: the team takes over, or D finishes it from home.

A-B.evidence: A proposes the team take over D's section (T1); B declines (T2). Later both accept D doing the work from home (T8, T32); neither addresses the other's view beyond that.

A-C.evidence: A proposes splitting the section with C (T3); C says they can't do it (T4). A then accepts D finishing it (T8) and tells everyone to focus on their own sections (T13).

A-D.evidence: A proposes taking over D's section (T1) and D insists on doing it (T5, T7). A then agrees: 'Okay, Agent D. If you're sure' (T8).

B-C.evidence: B and C each say they can't take on D's section (T2, T4), but neither speaks to the other. Both are later fine with D doing it.

B-D.evidence: B can't cover for D (T2). B offers condolences (T14) and D thanks them (T15). Both are consistent with D finishing the work alone.

C-D.evidence: C can't do D's analysis (T4); D says they will finish it themselves (T5). C offers condolences and D thanks C (T10-11).
